messages:
Sam: Heads up — opened a small PR to tidy up module exports and split a few big files into smaller packages. Need a couple of eyes for export style and any breakage risk. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4321 (summary below)

Sam: Changes: moved auth/* -> packages/auth, split utils/largeHelpers.ts into utils/{parse,format}.ts, removed default exports in a few modules, added index.ts barrels.

Sam: Quick code sample of change:
```ts
- export default function doThing(...) { ... }
+ export function doThing(...) { ... }
```

Maria: I'll take a look in ~30m. any integration tests that will fail? :thinking_face:

Sam: Ran unit suite locally, all green. CI has one lint error on named exports in packages/auth/index.ts (line 12). Not sure about downstream consumers — pinging @Alex and @Jessie for import surface checks.

Alex: @Sam can you paste the specific import that consumers should switch to? I can grep repos but quicker if you show one example.

Sam: Example: `import doThing from 'utils/largeHelpers'` -> `import { doThing } from 'utils/parse'` (or from the barrel `utils`). Will add migration notes in PR description.

Jessie: Prefer adding a single barrel in utils that re-exports named things to avoid churn: `export { doThing } from './parse'` — we can do that temporarily. Also please avoid changing public package name.

Sam: Good call. I'll add barrels and preserve package names. Pushed fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4321/commits/abc123

ci-bot: Lint check failed on packages/auth/index.ts: named-export-order — run `yarn lint:fix` and push.

Sam: Ran `yarn lint:fix` and pushed commit  def456. CI now shows unit tests passing, lint passing. CI: https://ci.redwood-inference.com/build/789

Maria: skimmed files — overall looks fine. left small comment about a relative path that should be absolute within package.

Alex: I did a quick grep across main repo, nothing else imports default from those modules. leaving an :eyes: and will approve after Maria's change.

Maria: updated comment addressed. approving now.

Alex: Approved. :shipit:

Sam: Thanks all — merging in ~10m during low traffic window. Will watch logs for 30m and rollback if any errors. :thumbsup:

Jessie: Thanks for handling follow-ups. Let me know if you want me to run a quick smoke check on staging.

Sam: Will do. Scheduled smoke run at 10:15. Posting results after.
